latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of anova-skill.

- Control Anova Precision Ovens and Cookers via WiFi WebSocket API.
- Start/stop cooking, set temperature, mode, fan speed, and elements remotely.
- Monitor cooking status and stream real-time telemetry.
- Supports both ovens (APO) and sous vide cookers (APC).
- Includes advanced cooking options (probe, steam, power, etc.).
- Requires Python 3.7+, websockets library, and Anova personal access token.
